name: chrome
description: Google Chrome on the bia profile (/home/bia/.config/bia-chrome — non-default so remote debugging works on Chrome 136+). Lifecycle: chrome_install / chrome_start / chrome_restart / chrome_stop / chrome_status. Page automation is Google chrome-devtools-mcp over remote debugging (same profile data): chrome_take_snapshot (accessibility tree with uids), chrome_click / chrome_fill / chrome_fill_form / chrome_press_key / chrome_type_text / chrome_hover, chrome_navigate_page / chrome_new_page / chrome_list_pages, chrome_take_screenshot, chrome_evaluate_script, chrome_list_network_requests, etc. For file inputs use CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles. Tab/window open and close arrive as system|chrome|[tab opened|closed] title/url (no need to poll). Passkeys are handled by the bia Chrome add-on via the secrets store. If Chrome is not installed, chrome_install says how to install the official Google Chrome (Google's .deb; it is not in Debian's sources). This is the browser, not the whole desktop — use mcp/screen for captchas that need OS-level clicks.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|open github in chrome -> discover(path='mcp/chrome', enable=true); chrome_navigate_page(url='https://github.com') or chrome_new_page(url='https://github.com')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|what is on the page -> chrome_take_snapshot()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|click the sign-in button -> chrome_take_snapshot(); chrome_click(uid='…')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|there is a captcha on the page -> discover(path='mcp/screen', enable=true); screen_shot(); screen_cursor_move_human(x=…, y=…); screen_click(x=…, y=…)
